calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) distinct_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx, sum(closing_value) val
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-22' AND DATE '2026-03-29'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'),
dups AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1)
SELECT etl_loaded_at, count(*) n, sum(closing_value) val, sum(closing_units) units, sum(receipts_units) rec, sum(adjustment_units) adj
FROM w JOIN dups USING (store_key, product_key) GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, count(*), sum(closing_value), sum(closing_units), sum(receipts_units), sum(adjustment_units) FROM w WHERE (store_key, product_key) NOT IN (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM dups)

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'),
dups AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*) > 1)
SELECT a.closing_units = b.closing_units same_units, a.closing_value = b.closing_value same_val, a.receipts_units = b.receipts_units same_rec, a.adjustment_units=b.adjustment_units same_adj, count(*) n
FROM w a JOIN w b ON a.store_key=b.store_key AND a.product_key=b.product_key AND a.etl_loaded_at < b.etl_loaded_at
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

calls.statement:
WITH stock AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_week, cp.category,
           SUM(f.closing_value) AS closing_value, COUNT(*) AS rows_n, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.store_id) AS stores
    FROM stock f
    JOIN dim_store s    ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p  ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = f.week_ending_date
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND cs.store_id < 900 AND cs.store_id <> 999
      AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 11
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       COUNT(*) AS weeks, MIN(stores) min_stores, MAX(stores) max_stores, MIN(rows_n) minrows, MAX(rows_n) maxrows,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_stock_value
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1,3 ORDER BY 3

SELECT f.week_ending_date, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_units,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.closing_value - f.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) val_mismatch,
  count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-22') f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE cs.region='West'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) dup_rows_west, sum(closing_value) dup_value_west FROM (
SELECT f.* FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE cs.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-03-08' AND f.etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-10 02:45:00')
